name: Quest POI
description: Quest points of interest shown on the player's world map, one row per quest objective blob. Sent to the client on quest POI query; the actual point coordinates are stored in quest_poi_points. Loaded by ObjectMgr::LoadQuestPOI.

fields.name: POI Id
fields.help: Id of this point of interest, unique per quest; referenced by quest_poi_points.

fields.name: Objective Index
fields.help: -1 = POI for the quest reward (quest ender), otherwise index (0-3) of the ReqCreatureOrGOId objective the POI belongs to.

fields.name: World Map Area
fields.help: WorldMapArea.dbc id of the map area the POI is displayed on.

fields.name: Floor Id
fields.help: Dungeon floor id (DungeonMap.dbc) for multi-floor maps, 0 = none.

fields.name: Unk3
fields.help: Unknown, sent to the client as-is.

fields.name: Unk4
fields.help: Unknown, sent to the client as-is.
